rawResult: You do all the tests in the browser from hand to hand to verify it fully works. Also, since the CMSify and eCommerceify features can be quite long, I want you to create a very fancy animation. The Sanity CMSify animation should be about detecting the boxes that will be editable and do an animation like React Scan. and the CMS-E5 can be a simple full screen on top of the page preview with some cards that are rotated and repeating over 45 degrees and a skeleton below it. The card should be gray with a white skeleton light below it and the background behind the card should be black.
